detail.longDescription: A new version of Grove (1.8.0) has been released. Some highlights: - A smart suggestions strip that helps inserts some drawers and blocks while typing - Archive locations support `%s` for the current file name, as in Emacs; see Tips & Tricks. - Typing `<q`, `<e`, `<s`, `:PRO` or `:LOG` (any case) offers a chip inserting that block or drawer; see Tips & Tricks - Various bug fixes and performance improvements Get the latest version on GitHub Releases or Obtainium https:// github.com/rrajath/grove # emacs # apps # productivity # orgmode
